name: ui-writing
description: 日本語の UI 文言を書き、レビューするための規範

interface.shortDescription: Write and review Japanese UI text
interface.longDescription: Rules for writing and reviewing Japanese UI text by role: titles, labels, buttons, dialogs, error messages, and empty states. Decides what each place needs to say before shortening it, and keeps terms consistent with a glossary.
defaultPrompt: Review the UI text in this dialog
